service.method: SELECT CFGL.HOUSE_CODE , CFGL.COMPANY_CODE , CFGL.CONT_FORM_NO , CFGL.ADD_DATE , CFGL.ADD_USER_ID , USMT.USER_NAME_LOC AS ADD_USER , CFGL.DEL_FLAG , CFGL.CONT_FORM_NAME , CFGL.CONT_FORM_DESC , CFGL.STATUS , CFGL.USE_FLAG , CFGL.CATEGORY , CFGL.CONT_METHOD , CFGL.USE_FROM , CFGL.USE_TO , CFGL.SIGNER_CODE FROM SCFGL CFGL INNER JOIN SUSMT USMT ON CFGL.HOUSE_CODE = USMT.HOUSE_CODE AND CFGL.COMPANY_CODE = USMT.COMPANY_CODE AND CFGL.ADD_USER_ID = USMT.USER_ID WHERE CFGL.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND CFGL.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND CFGL.CONT_TYPE = ${CONT_TYPE} AND CFGL.CONT_FORM_NO = $S{CONT_NO} AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(CFGL.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' AND CFGL.STATUS != $S{STATUS} AND ( 1=1 AND CFGL.CONT_FORM_NAME like '%' || $S{F_KEYWORD} || '%' AND CFGL.CATEGORY IN ($INS{F_CATEGORY}) AND CFGL.CONT_METHOD IN ($INS{F_CONT_METHOD}) AND CFGL.USE_FROM <= $S{F_DATE_TO} AND CFGL.USE_TO >= $S{F_DATE_FROM} AND CFGL.CONT_METHOD = $S{F_STATUS} ) ORDER BY CFGL.USE_FROM ,CFGL.USE_TO
